text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober is literally shaking with excitement. It's clear she can't wait to show everyone how much she's improved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She promises to exceed my expectations for her on the track, and with those encouraging words, she sets off for her big race.
